method: Independent direct inspection of full source pixels through view_image; source bytes verified against the frozen manifest. No inference rerun.
scope: Local development annotation audit only. Frozen labels, metrics and policy remain unchanged.
interpretation: confirmed means a human region is clearly visible; uncertain means the pixels do not establish human presence; unsupported means this inspection found no clear human region supporting the existing label. Unsupported is not a guarantee that no human is present.
